repos_data.description: A polyglot document intelligence framework with a Rust core. Extract text, metadata, images, and structured data from 101 formats (115 file extensions) plus code intelligence for 371 code languages. 15 language bindings — Rust, Python, Ruby, Java, Go, PHP, Elixir, C#, TypeScript — plus CLI, REST API, and MCP server.

A polyglot document intelligence framework with a Rust core. Extract text, metadata, and structured information from PDFs, Office documents, images, and 76+ formats. Available for Rust, Python, Ruby, Java, Go, PHP, Elixir, C#, R, C, TypeScript (Node/Bun/Wasm/Deno)- or use via CLI, REST API, or MCP server.
